name: Erika
source:
Erika's quiet, but not soft. When she speaks, it's sharp, almost cutting, and then there's the part she doesn't advertise… she's a Kitsune. Which shouldn't even be possible. The Veilkeepers wiped out the Kitsune clans in Japan centuries ago, or so the records say. So either the records are wrong, or Erika is. Either way, her existence feels like a mistake someone buried on purpose.

[Edited From In-Game Description]
